# Icon

Inline SVG icons on a 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps, currentColor, always aria-hidden (the adjacent word carries meaning).

`HomeFix.Icon` · Foundations

## Use

```jsx
<HomeFix.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="HomeFix.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
